text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. How about it? For Gaia's siesta— 
Shall I shake you up a drink?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Behold! The brilliance of my beloved 
shaker! Thanks to yesterday's Sabbath, the 
Creator's day of rest, I was able to 
polish it to my heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, it is merely an imitation of 
Bacchus, but—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"With my sweet nectar, I shall allow you, 
too, to taste a moment of respite!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Tanino Gimlet was able to 
spend a meaningful day off.
